title: Reduce duplicated GitHub Actions work while preserving deterministic WLS evidence gates

github_evidence: PR #13 completed the single-root repository migration and passed all required exact-head matrices before merge.
Provider Hub draft commits triggered seven workflow families and repeated the same full regression, lint, type, security, build, and evolution checks across many jobs.
Later jobs across every workflow terminated before any step started and exposed no logs, so repeated reruns produced cost without code evidence.

objective: Establish a repository-native CI cost governor that assigns each evidence class to one workflow, cancels superseded branch runs, keeps bounded cross-platform pull-request gates, and reserves full compatibility matrices for main or explicit dispatch.
forbidden_changes: Do not remove full regression, lint, type, security, build, repository-invariant, evolution, or control-plane evidence classes.
Do not weaken owner approval, promotion, rollback, Claim Ceiling, or canonical runtime authority.
Do not treat CI jobs that never started as code failures or code successes.
Do not add direct pushes to main, writable workflow permissions, paid runners, or external secrets.
Do not reduce the post-merge main matrix below Ubuntu and Windows on Python 3.11 and 3.13.

commands: python -m ruff check source/src source/tests source/scripts
conditions: Only ci.yml owns the full regression and complete quality stack.
ET001, ET002, and ET003 verifiers are consolidated into one focused workflow.
Pull-request WLS CI remains cross-platform on Ubuntu and Windows.
The full Ubuntu and Windows Python 3.11 and 3.13 matrices still run on main or manual dispatch.
Core recurring workflows cancel superseded runs for the same pull request or ref.
Repository invariants reject reintroduction of duplicate evolution workflows or a second full-quality-stack owner.
No direct workflow write to main or external secret is introduced.
evidence_required: repository-invariant report with full_suite_owners and quality_stack_owners
exact-head pull-request checks once GitHub Actions can start jobs
comparison of pre-governor and post-governor job counts for a representative source pull request

stop_conditions: Stop if cost reduction removes an evidence class rather than assigning it to one owner.
Stop if pull requests lose all Windows execution.
Stop if main loses the four-cell operating-system and Python matrix.
Stop if the invariant checker cannot identify the sole full regression owner.
Stop repeated reruns while jobs terminate before their first step.
dependencies: GitHub Actions capacity restored before exact-head verification

evidence: PR #13 exact-head workflows all passed before merge
PR #14 later workflow jobs repeatedly returned steps=null with no retrievable logs
unknowns: The connector does not expose the account-level reason that Actions jobs are not starting.
Exact post-governor job counts remain pending until one workflow run can start.
output_contract.next_action: Keep this branch without an open pull request until Actions capacity is restored; then open one draft PR, run the reduced topology once, review exact-head evidence, and merge before reopening Provider Hub.

handoff.summary: CI ownership has been deduplicated on an isolated branch without opening a noisy pull request.
handoff.blocker: GitHub Actions currently does not start jobs, so exact-head verification is pending.
